answer: Reaching the summit requires tribute, not tenure. Each rung of the spiral demands a relic: a signed proof from an established holder that the newcomer performed a named task, and one relic cannot back two applicants, so relaying it collapses them into a single seat. The k-th rung costs k times the prior tribute and burns it, so running n aliases costs about n cubed while they still need n distinct relic holders. Relics are non-transferable and expire each epoch, so a coalition cannot stockpile lineage or buy its way upward.
